scope.summary: Define a portfolio-level own-when-proven/day-0 ownership budget contract, register it for root-hub discovery, and create founder-call follow-up cards only for human-only ownership rulings.
explicit_non_claims: No product code, runtime service, or ADR implementation is changed.
The proposed ownership-ratchet gate is planned; it is not mechanically enforced until implemented as a branch-protected cloud-ci/Rust gate behind oya-ci-required.
The contract does not make production-ready or hyperscaler-grade claims; those remain governed by /specs/hyperscaler-production-readiness-claim-contract.json.
Founder-only ownership decisions remain blocked on human judgment through the created Kanban cards.

hyperscaler_lens.north_star: Oyatie should own differentiating infrastructure only when a named forcing function and capacity model justify it, instead of spawning too many simultaneous bespoke substrates on day 0.
hyperscaler_lens.scale_property: A one-slot major OWN_DAY0 budget and trigger-based OWN_EARLY/DEFER_VENDORED defaults force portfolio sequencing across DB, Kubernetes, container build, workflow, DCIM, identity, clients, verticals, CI, policy, and node-OS decisions.

facets.F1_correctness: The contract names one allowed major day-0 ownership slot, defines evidence required to exceed it, and maps BVB-02/03/04/06/07/08/10/11 plus specific-tech A4/C2/D2/F1/F2/F3/F4/F5 to dispositions.
facets.F2_tests: JSON syntax validation, custom required-mapping/root-hub/registry/card invariant checks, git diff --check, and Kanban card visibility checks passed.
facets.F3_maintainability: The contract is a single machine-readable spec with source authorities, unified rubric, budget, claim ceilings, decision mappings, gate proposal, and worker guidance.
facets.F4_compatibility: Root-hub and artifact registry additions are additive; no generated faces or product/runtime APIs are changed.
facets.F5_security: The gate proposal explicitly rejects unsupported ownership-escalation claims and preserves the existing cloud-ci/Rust gate authority boundary rather than adding legacy CLI authority.
facets.F6_privacy: The change contains architecture-governance metadata only and introduces no tenant, customer, or personal data processing.
facets.F7_operability: Three blocked founder-call cards make human-only decisions visible instead of leaving audit prose as an implicit blocker.
facets.F8_performance: No runtime path is affected; future gate cost is bounded to ownership-claim scans over docs/spec/registry paths.
facets.F9_compliance: Claim ceilings point back to the hyperscaler production-readiness claim contract and prevent false mechanically-enforced/production-ready claims.
facets.F10_reversibility: Rollback is limited to one new spec, one root-hub entry, one artifact-registry row, this evidence file, and Kanban follow-up cards/comments.
facets.F11_observability: The artifact-registry row defines a planned ownership-claims metric and the Kanban cards provide durable board evidence.
facets.F13_migration: The contract supports migration from per-ADR ownership prose to a portfolio-level cloud-ci/Rust gate without touching generated artifacts or retired oya CLI authority.

verification_plan: custom Python invariant check for required BVB/specific-tech mappings, one-slot budget, root-hub entry, registry row, gate id, and three founder-call cards
